chunks: Chapter on the causes and reasons of hajj.

The Shaykh, the author of this book—may Allah have mercy on him—said: I have compiled the chains of transmission for the causes which I am going to mention from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and from the Imams عليهم السلام in my book Jāmiʿ ʿIlal al-Ḥajj.

key_terms.أَسَانِيدَ: chains of transmission of hadith reports
key_terms.النَّبِيِّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْحَجِّ: the ritual pilgrimage to the Sacred House

ai.seo_question: Where did the author place the full chains of transmission for the hadiths on the reasons behind hajj?
ai.summary: This passage introduces a chapter on the reasons and wisdoms behind hajj. The author states that the full chains of transmission for these reports from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and the Imams عليهم السلام were presented in his separate work on the causes of hajj.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
The author of this book, Shaykh (may Allah (swt) have mercy on him), states:
"I have compiled the chains of transmission for the causes (and wisdoms) of Hajj, which I will mention here, as narrated from the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) and the Imams (as), in my book titled Jami‘ ‘Ilal al-Hajj (The Compilation of the Causes of Hajj)."
